sources.entry: Excalidraw | Virtual whiteboard for hand-drawn style diagrams

summary.one_liner: Excalidraw is an open-source, hand-drawn style virtual whiteboard, available as the excalidraw.com web app and as an npm package for embedding in React apps.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds the Excalidraw editor, distributed as the @excalidraw/excalidraw npm package, plus the source for the excalidraw.com showcase app. The editor provides an infinite canvas with a hand-drawn look and tools including rectangle, circle, diamond, arrow, line, free-draw and eraser, with arrow binding and labeled arrows. It supports image insertion, shape libraries, dark mode, localization, undo/redo, zoom and panning. Drawings can be exported to PNG, SVG or the clipboard, and saved as an open .excalidraw JSON file. The hosted app adds PWA offline use, real-time collaboration, end-to-end encryption, browser autosave, and read-only shareable links. The README also lists a VS Code extension as an integration.
use_cases: embed a whiteboard in a React app
export drawings to SVG or PNG
notable: Open format: drawings export as plain .excalidraw JSON files
Hosted excalidraw.com app includes end-to-end encryption and real-time collaboration
Available as an embeddable npm package for integration into other apps
Local-first: autosaves to the browser and works offline as a PWA on the hosted app
caveats: Self-hosting the excalidraw.com app is not described in the README; the README points to a Development Guide for running the repository locally

Some features (such as the hosted app's collaboration and encryption) are part of the excalidraw.com app rather than the npm package, and the README says they will be added as npm plugins in the future
Excalidraw+ is a separate paid offering mentioned in the README
